## About
Lynwood Auto Dismantling is a salvage yard specializing in European car parts, with a large inventory of late model foreign and domestic parts. We carry parts from BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, Audi, Saab, Jaguar and Volvo, along with engines, transmissions, suspensions and doors.
Whether you're a car owner, a collision or auto repair shop, or a dealership, we can help. As a member of a huge network of nationwide salvage yards, we can help track down what isn't here.
One customer came to us for a pump the dealer couldn't get, had it installed and wrote, "Thanks again Joe for the help." Lynwood Auto Dismantling is rated 4 from 94 Google reviews.

## Services
- Free Parts Locating Service: Tell us what you need and we'll help find it through our network of salvage yards.
- Late Model Auto Parts: A large inventory of late model foreign and domestic parts.
- European car parts: Our specialty. Parts from BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, Audi, Saab, Jaguar and Volvo.
- Engines: Used engines in stock in our yard.
- Transmissions: A range of transmissions on hand.
- Suspensions: A wide range of suspension parts.
- Car doors: A selection of doors in stock.
- Cars for sale: Cars for sale on our lot, too.

## FAQ
Q: What makes do you carry parts for?
A: European parts are our specialty, including BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, Audi, Saab, Jaguar and Volvo, and we also carry late model domestic parts.

Q: Do you sell to shops and dealers?
A: Yes. Car owners, collision and auto repair shops, and dealerships all buy from us.

Q: How can I pay?
A: You can pay online through our PayPal portal. We accept PayPal, Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover, as well as debit cards, bank drafts and eChecks.

Q: Where exactly are you?
A: On the east side of the train tracks that divide S. Alameda Street, at the corner of S. Alameda and Santa Ana Blvd/Fernwood Ave. Call us if you'd like more detailed directions.
